vectors.title: Review native memory-copy capacity invariants
vectors.rationale: Native copy operations require a source length and destination capacity review across pointer and buffer assignments.

reviewObligations.riskStatement: A copy operation may use a length that exceeds its destination capacity after pointer assignment.
reviewObligations.evidenceRequirement: The review identifies a copy operation and a source-backed capacity mismatch condition.

limitations: Static review does not execute native code or prove allocator and compiler behavior.
